body.name: shrinking-overlap specialization handle
body.construction: For any deterministic radius path \(C_T=1+\delta_T\ge1\), \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{loc}}\) records the normalized distance \(q_{C_T}=\delta_T/(1+\delta_T)\), the observable score family \(\{Z_t(k):0\le k<T\}\), and the radius-adaptive depth \(\kappa_T(C_T)\) from \(\mathrm{def{:}history\text{-}depth}\).  It names these inputs to the local corollary and makes no risk assertion by definition.
